parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the Prometheus instance.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the monitoring configuration. Valid values for a Prometheus instance for Container Service: ServiceMonitor, PodMonitor, CustomJob, and Probe. Valid values for a Prometheus instance for ECS: CustomJob and Probe.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms list-prometheus-monitoring --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --type serviceMonitor --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms ListPrometheusMonitoring --region cn-hangzhou --Type serviceMonitor --ClusterId cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
